source_caption_text:
Never forget when NBA YoungBoy started rapping like the 4th Migo 😤🔥

Migos and YoungBoy Never Broke Again come together on “Need It,” and the chemistry between them feels natural from the start. Each artist brings their own sound to the track, but they all fit comfortably over Buddah Bless’s production without making the song feel crowded.

Offset, Quavo and Takeoff each bring their familiar flows and melodies, while YoungBoy adds a different kind of energy with his delivery. The way they switch between verses and bounce off each other’s styles makes the collaboration work so well, especially considering how different their sounds can be.

“Need It” is a great example of two different rap styles coming together without either side having to change what makes them unique. YoungBoy fits right in with the Migos trio, making the collaboration feel like a natural match.

#migos #youngboyneverbrokeagain #hiphop
